entries.d654248b3e433a87: Spherical darpan ke liye naya Cartesian sign convention batayein. Cartesian sign conventions spherical mirrors ke liye hain: i) Vastu hamesha darpan ke baayein taraf rakha jata hai. ii) Sabhi doori jo pramukh dhuri (X-Axis) ke saath hai, darpan ke pole se maapi jati hai. iii) Pole ke baayein taraf ki dooriyan (-ve X Axis) negative hoti hain. iv) Pole ke daayein taraf ki dooriyan (+ve X Axis) positive hoti hain. v) Pramukh dhuri ke upar maapi gayi dooriyan (+Y-axis) positive hoti hain. vi) Pramukh dhuri ke neeche maapi gayi dooriyan (-Y-axis) negative hoti hain. Ek ray diagram banayein jo ek vastu ke pratibimb ko darshata hai jo convex lens ke curvature ke kendra par rakha gaya hai, pratibimb ki prakriti, sthal aur aakar likhein. Jab vastu curvature ke kendra par hota hai lens ke doosri taraf, to pratibimb real, inverted aur vastu ke aakar ke barabar hota hai.
